notes: The painting is the page (history/page): the title and its line under it are the painting's; the tab words and the seven painted rows are erased.

The tabs are ALL's lit plate and ON ME's unlit one, each word erased and set in type (the painting spells the second MY RADS): Cinzel 700 at 27, the painted caps' 18-unit core, near white. The page lights the chosen one.

The list is live: a row per battle from the four the painting shows (history/row_won, _lost, _held, _raided), 113 tall at the painting's 121 pitch, the opponent on the upper plate in the colour they wear, what happened and when on the lower one, the gold in its box.
One stretch band down the middle of the list panel (its erased ground and the frame's two sides are the same all the way down): on 941x2040 the list shows three rows more.
